create_image_jitter_transform: create an ImageJitter transform that applies randomized brightness, contrast, sharpness, and color jitter to a PIL image
use_transformtypedict: use transformtypedict to map transform names like Brightness or Contrast to PIL ImageEnhance classes
apply_random_jitter: apply random image jitter with configurable alpha factors to a PIL image using ImageJitter
review_ImageJitter_call: review the ImageJitter __call__ method that computes random enhancement factors and applies PIL ImageEnhance transforms
refactor_ImageJitter_init: refactor the ImageJitter __init__ to accept a dict of transform names and alpha values for configurable jitter
